manifest.solver_mode: marginalized (== clairvoyant at K<=2; fair-legit truth)
manifest.fair_arm: PIMC: 8 x fresh HeuristicMCTS on unseen-deck-reshuffled board copies, root visits pooled (dedup by child identity), argmax pooled-N (primary) / pooled-Q (secondary)
manifest.clair_arm: production best_action on the true deck order (Q, N tiebreak)

notes: at K<=2 the deck has <=1 hidden draw beyond the current tile — clairvoyance advantage is structurally SMALL here (this measures the endgame-decision tax, not the midgame tax)

at deck_len<=1 the unseen-deck reshuffle is an identity permutation (the single hidden tile's identity is inferable from the public multiset), so the two arms differ only by search RNG and aggregation (K pooled searches vs one) — zero hidden information; see deck_len_dist for how much of the sample is in that regime
